findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: The caulking on the middle sinks in the men and women bathrooms were observed to be in disrepair. Discussed with the PIC. The PIC assured inspectors that the caulking will be done either today or within a couple days. Ensure that closed spaces such as the space between the sinks and the wall is caulk and properly sealed to provide a smooth and easily cleanable surface.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Inspectors observed the hand sink in the back of the kitchen area opposite the walk-ins to be out of paper towels for proper hand drying. Discussed with PIC and PIC got the paper towel dispenser refilled. Ensure that the hand sink is always supplied with the relevant accessories at all times to ensure proper hand washing.
findings.citation_text: 6-301.12 Hand Drying Provision. Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; or (C) A heated-air hand drying device; or (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: The accumulation of soils were observed on baffles of the ice machine. Discussed with PIC and PIC ensured inspectors that a work order had been submitted to get the ice machine cleaned. PIC had the technician pull the ice machine apart and got it cleaned while inspectors were on site. Ensure that food contact surfaces such as the ice machine is monitored and cleaned at a regular frequency.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: Accumulated soils were observed on the grates of the shelves opposite the mixing station in the kitchen area. Discussed with PIC and PIC ensured inspectors that the grates will be clean. Ensure that non-food contact surfaces such as the shelves use for storing utensils and dishes is monitored and cleaned at a at a regular frequency.
findings.citation_text: 4-602.13 Nonfood-Contact Surfaces. NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Sewage and waste water properly disposed.
findings.comment: Inspectors observed water sitting at the brink of the floor drain adjacent the mop sink in the back area. PIC was made aware of the water drainage and PIC said that they will get the drain checked. Ensure that drainages from point of discharge are monitored and cleaned at a regular frequency to avoid sewage backup.
findings.citation_text: 5-403.12 Other Liquid Wastes and Rainwater. Condensate drainage and other nonSEWAGE liquids and rainwater shall be drained from point of discharge to disposal according to LAW.
